speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This could involve providing more accessible lifts or implementing priority access arrangements that improve the lift user experience.

speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Creating an inclusive society extends beyond the provision of accessible facilities and features.

speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: BCA partners with the Singapore Kindness Movement to promote gracious use of accessible facilities including initiatives to encourage the public to prioritise lift access for those with greater needs.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: In regard to the Code of standards for the lifts that have been indicated in the BCA standards, does it include safety standards for personal mobility aid (PMA) and personal mobility devices (PMDs)?

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: And also, have the size changes that possibly evolved over time?

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: So, it may not be possible to accommodate very large PMAs in lifts, depending on the building size and configuration.

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: So, best to get the suggestions in early.
